# Sri Surya Educational Institutions

> Premier co-educational institution in Narasapuram, West Godavari, Andhra Pradesh offering Junior College, Degree College, and dedicated coaching for IIT-JEE, NEET, EAMCET and Board exams since 2005.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of programs, achievements, top rankers and campus highlights.
- [About](/about): History, leadership and philosophy of Sri Surya Educational Institutions.
- [Vision](/vision): Mission, vision, values and guiding principles.
- [Academics](/academics): Programs offered — MPC, BiPC, CEC, MEC, HEC, B.Com Honours, B.Sc Honours, IIT Foundation, NEET and JEE coaching.
- [Faculty](/faculty): Profiles of our 80+ expert faculty members.
- [Achievements](/achievements): State ranks, top scorers and academic milestones.
- [Events](/events): Campus events, talent tests and felicitation ceremonies.
- [Community](/community): Forum and community engagement.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone numbers and admission inquiries.
